The Police Inspector of Basavanagudi Women P.S. has filed chargesheet against Accused No.1 and 2 for the offences punishable U/s. 498A r/w/s 34 of IPC.& Sec.3 & 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
 2.
The criminal law has been set into motion based on the first information statement of Smt.Priyanka N. Kiran.
The gist of the prosecution case is that, complainant got married accused No.1 on 15-04-2012.
At the time of marriage, the accused No.1 demanded parents of the complainant to give Rs.One lakh and gold ornaments as dowry.
CW2 and CW3 had given Rs.75,000/-in cash, gold neck chain and gold finger ring as dowry.

After the marriage, when complainant was residing with accused No.1 and 2 at Banashankari, Bangalore accused No.2 removed the maid from the work and made complainant to work and made her to cook only with the items given to her.
Accused No.1 and 2 were not liking the food prepared by the complainant.
Accused No.1 used to go out with his friend and come home drunk everyday and accused No.2  3  C.C.No.24747/2019 was supporting accused No.1.

When complainant got pregnant,
accused No.1 did not bear the medical expenses and was demanding complainant to bring Rs.3 to 4 lakhs for house repair work.
As complainant did not bring the said amount, accused No.1 did not take the responsibility of the complainant and told that he would give divorce to her.
Accused No.2 told complainant and CW-2 to take complainant back to his house.

When complainant used to visit the house of accused persons, accused No.1 used to quarrel with the complainant and used to abuse her and assault her and Priyanka N Kiran vs Kiran C on 14 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/61090939/
2 used to throw her clothes out of the house.

sentences.text: Thereafter accused No.1 did not pay the school fees and both accused No.1 locked the house and got shifted and thereby caused physical and mental cruelty to the complainant in demand of dowry.
Based on the information of Smt.Priyanka N. Kiran.,a case in Cr.No.89/2019 came to be registered against the accused No.1 and 2 for the aforesaid offences .
3. After completion of the investigation, the P.I. of Basavanagudi Women P.S. has filed chargesheet against accused No.1 and 2 for the aforesaid offences.

On receipt of charge sheet,
this court took cognizance of the alleged offences.
Pursuant to the issuance and service of summons, accused No.1 and 2 entered  4  C.C.No.24747/2019 appearance and were enlarged on bail.

The prosecution papers was furnished to the accused No.1 and 2 as required U/s.207 of Cr.P.C.
 4.

Before framing charge an opportunity of being heard was provided to the accused No.1 and 2 and after hearing them and the prosecution and as there was sufficient materials, the charge for the aforesaid offences was framed and same was read over to the accused No.1 and 2 in the language known to them to which,
the accused No.1 and 2 pleaded not guilty and claimed to be tried.
The plea of the accused No.1 and 2 was recorded.
Thereafter, the matter was set down for prosecution evidence.
5. In order to prove the charges, the prosecution has examined PW-1 and got marked Ex.P1 and Ex.P2 documents.

sentences.text: 6. Heard arguments on both the sides.
I have Perused the materials on record.

7. The following points arise for my determination:-
 1) Whether the prosecution proves beyond all reasonable  doubt that the accused No.1 and 2 caused physical and  mental cruelty to the complainant in demand of dowry,
 and thereby accused No.1 and 2 have committed the  offences punishable U/s. 498A r/w/s 34 of IPC.& Sec.3  & 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.?
 5  C.C.No.24747/2019  2) what order?
 8.

My finding to the above points are as under:-
 Point No.1 ........In the Negative.
 Point No.2........ As per final order, for the following:-
 R E A SON S  9. POINT No.1 :- It is the fundamental principle of criminal jurisprudence that the prosecution has to prove its case beyond reasonable doubt.

In order to bring home the guilt of the accused No.1 and 2, the prosecution has examined complainant Smt.
Priyanka as PW-1 and got marked Ex.P.1 and Ex.P.2 documents.
Ex.P1 is the first information statement and Ex.P.2 is the spot panchanama.

10. PW-1 in her examination-in-chief deposed that her marriage with accused No.1 was performed on 15-04-2012 and after the marriage, accused No.1 and 2 looked after her well and deposed accused No.1 and 2 did not subjected her to any physical Priyanka N Kiran vs Kiran C on 14 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/61090939/
4

entities.text: Priyanka N Kiran vs Kiran C
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: and mental cruelty in demand of dowry.
PW-1 deposed that there was petty quarrel between her and accused persons in respect to family issues, for which she went to the police station, there the police have took her signature on documents.
PW-1 identified  6  C.C.No.24747/2019 Ex.P.1 first information statement and also identified her signature at Ex.P1.
PW-1 also identified Ex.P.2 spot Panchanama and her signature at Ex.P2
and she pleaded her ignorance about the contents of Ex.P1.
The learned Sr.APP treated PW-1 as hostile witness and cross examined her.
During which PW-1 admitted that she and accused person have compromised the matter and denied all other suggestions.
Though PW-1 was cross examined by the prosecution, nothing worth could be elicited.
11. On appreciation of entire materials on record, it is apparent that PW-1 being the informant, key and material witness has turned hostile to the prosecution case.
Therefore, this court was pleased to reject the prayer of the learned Sr.APP to summon other chargesheeted witnesses.

Even, if the summons was issued to other chargesheeted witnesses, no purpose would be served as the material witness has given go-bye to her own statement and also the valuable time of the court would be saved.
As such other charge sheeted witnesses were dropped and prosecution evidence was taken as closed.
In view of the material witness, turning hostile the prosecution has failed to bring home the guilt of the accused persons beyond reasonable doubt.
Accordingly, I answer Point No.1 in the Negative.
